environment.description: Bare-metal deployment on EC2 c5.xlarge, Go 1.21, Gin 1.9.1, direct TCP exposure on port 8080 via public IP. No reverse proxy, no rate limiting, no connection throttling. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on port 8080. Instance runs with default kernel parameters (no ASLR hardening beyond default). Application compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1.
